summary.zh: 通过 Thin SAPClaw 只读会计凭证证据计算采购订单项目的 GR/IR 未结余额、最后活动日和账龄，并在证据不完整时保守停止。
summary.en: Uses read-only Thin SAPClaw accounting evidence to calculate PO-item GR/IR residuals, last activity and ageing, failing closed when evidence is incomplete.

zh: 公司代码
关键日期
可选采购订单、工厂和 GR/IR 科目
账龄阈值与分桶
SAP 凭证链证据（自动查询）
en: Company code
Key date
Optional purchase orders, plants and GR/IR accounts
Ageing threshold and buckets
Automatically queried SAP evidence

zh: PO/项目级 GR 和 IR 数量与金额
未结余额与币种
最后活动日、账龄及分桶
源凭证引用
完整性结论
en: PO-item GR and IR quantities and values
Residual and currency
Last activity, ageing and bucket
Source document references
Completeness conclusion

zh: 严格只读，不执行 MB5S 或任何 SAP 写入
完整分页后才计算
混合公司代码币种、重复业务键或不可换算单位时返回 inconclusive
en: Strictly read-only; never executes MB5S or any SAP write
Calculates only after complete pagination
Returns inconclusive for mixed company currencies, duplicate keys or non-convertible units

description.zh: 规范化公司代码、关键日期、可选范围和账龄策略。
description.en: Normalizes company code, key date, optional scope and ageing policy.

zh: 要求公司代码和关键日期。
校验账龄阈值非负，分桶边界唯一且递增。
采购订单、工厂和科目仅作为显式服务端过滤条件。
en: Require company code and key date.
Require a non-negative threshold and unique ascending bucket boundaries.
Use purchase orders, plants and accounts only as explicit server-side filters.

purpose.zh: 输入解析阶段不访问 SAP。
purpose.en: Input parsing does not access SAP.

description.zh: 确认运行时健康、可执行且严格只读。
description.en: Confirms the runtime is healthy, executable and strictly read-only.

zh: 调用健康检查并要求 read_only=true。
读取会计凭证立方体 schema 并确认所需字段。
服务不可执行或权限不足时停止。
en: Call health and require read_only=true.
Read the accounting-item cube schema and verify required fields.
Stop when the service is not executable or authorization fails.

purpose.zh: 验证实体字段和可执行性。

title.zh: 查询 GR/IR 会计证据

description.zh: 按公司代码、关键日期和可选范围读取会计凭证项目。
description.en: Reads accounting document items by company, key date and optional scope.

zh: 查询 A_OperationalAcctgDocItemCube。
只选择 PO、供应商、物料、工厂、日期、借贷、数量、金额、币种和冲销字段。
跟随分页直到 has_next=false，并保存 run id、system、client 和实际过滤条件。
不调用 CDS-only 的 I_PurchaseOrderHistoryAPI01。
en: Query A_OperationalAcctgDocItemCube.
Select only PO, supplier, material, plant, date, debit/credit, quantity, amount, currency and reversal fields.
Follow pagination until has_next=false and store run id, system, client and actual filters.
Do not call the CDS-only I_PurchaseOrderHistoryAPI01.

purpose.zh: 提供 GR/IR 会计行及 PO 引用。
purpose.en: Provides GR/IR accounting lines and PO references.

purpose.zh: 执行受控、分页、只读 GET。
purpose.en: Executes controlled, paged, read-only GET requests.

description.zh: 拒绝缺页、重复键、缺字段和非只读来源。
description.en: Rejects missing pages, duplicate keys, missing fields and non-read-only sources.

zh: 要求 completeness.complete=true、source_complete=true 和 read_only=true。
用公司代码、年度、会计凭证和项目检测重复业务键。
校验过账日期、PO 项目、公司代码金额与币种字段。
任何错误都返回 inconclusive，不输出余额。
en: Require completeness.complete=true, source_complete=true and read_only=true.
Detect duplicate business keys using company, year, accounting document and item.
Validate posting date, PO item, company-code amount and currency fields.
Return inconclusive without residuals for any error.

description.zh: 按 PO 项目净额处理 GR、IR、退货、贷项和冲销。
description.en: Nets GR, IR, returns, credits and reversals by PO item.

zh: 依据来源类型、参考凭证类型和会计凭证类型归类 GR/IR。
依据借贷标识和冲销标识计算公司代码币种净额。
服务采购订单允许数量单位为空，但仍以金额核对。
以最后有效过账日期计算账龄并按配置分桶。
en: Classify GR/IR by explicit source, reference type and accounting document type.
Use debit/credit and reversal indicators to net company-code currency amounts.
Allow service POs to omit quantity units while still reconciling value.
Calculate age from the last valid posting date and apply configured buckets.

purpose.zh: 执行可解释净额和账龄规则。
purpose.en: Applies explainable netting and ageing rules.

description.zh: 输出未结项目、币种分桶总额和源凭证。
description.en: Returns open items, currency/bucket totals and source documents.

zh: 输出 PO、项目、供应商、物料、工厂、GR/IR 数量和值。
输出未结余额、公司代码币种、最后活动日、账龄和分桶。
按币种和分桶汇总，绝不跨公司代码币种相加。
提供稳定 JSON 或 Markdown，并保留 source_complete 和 read_only 标志。
en: Return PO, item, supplier, material, plant and GR/IR quantities and values.
Return residual, company currency, last activity date, age and bucket.
Total by currency and bucket and never combine company-code currencies.
Provide stable JSON or Markdown with source_complete and read_only flags.
